description: This file contains utility functions for handling HTTP requests, rendering errors, and OAuth-related UI responses in the Mattermost server, specifically within the channels/utils package.

methods.name: CheckOrigin
methods.description: Checks if the request's Origin header matches allowed origins, allowing '*' as a wildcard.

methods.name: OriginChecker
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if a request's origin is allowed based on the provided allowedOrigins string.

methods.name: CheckEmbeddedCookie
methods.description: Checks if the 'MMEMBED' cookie is set to '1', indicating embedded Mattermost in an iframe.

methods.name: RenderWebAppError
methods.description: Renders an error page for web applications, signing the error message.

methods.name: RenderWebError
methods.description: Renders an error page with a specific HTTP status, signing the URL for security.

methods.name: RenderMobileAuthComplete
methods.description: Displays a mobile OAuth completion message with redirect and close instructions.

methods.name: RenderMobileError
methods.description: Displays an error message in a mobile-friendly format, with fallback URL if needed.

methods.name: RenderMobileMessage
methods.description: Outputs a simple HTML page with a message for mobile devices.
